_coverage_rationale: REF-DEAL-FUND-1: Fund / SPV archetype — long-biased concentrated equity hedge fund LP. Two documents: 33-page pitch deck / investor presentation (PDF) and 2-page performance summary (PDF). No XLSX. Tests fund_spv classification, fund_ops stage, AUM-not-as-raise-amount noise guard, and portfolio-company-revenue noise guard. Anchors the fund/LP regression lane.
_failure_modes_targeted: BUG-MFUND-1: revenue = '$4' (amount: 3.6) extracted from a KGC (Kinross Gold) case study on page 18 of the PD PDF. Text: 'Case Study - KGC Amidst Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Kinross faced a 50% sell-off, despite only 10% of revenue coming from Russian operations.' The DPU extracted '10% of revenue' as a revenue signal for the fund. This is a portfolio holding case study — NOT fund revenue. There is no operating revenue for this fund.

BUG-MFUND-2: funding_stage_v1.funding_stage = 'pre_seed' — incorrect for an operational hedge fund LP that has been running since April 2019 with $222mm+ AUM and a 762% total net return track record. The fund is not a startup. The pre_seed classification fires because the fund has no product/milestone/raise signals matching an operating company, causing the stage model to fall back to 'IDEA' / pre_seed.

BUG-MFUND-3: business_archetype_v1 from DIO/worker layer is null — the worker does not emit a business_archetype_v1 value for fund deals. The fund_spv classification is correctly captured in investment_analysis_overview_v2.archetype and dio_context.deal_type, but the DIO-layer archetype analyzer produces no output. This is expected current behavior but means fund archetype evidence rules are not populated.

BUG-MFUND-4: capital_logic_v1.raise.sources references soft-deleted document IDs (93c64280, 2b55cd4c) — duplicate uploads were soft-deleted but their extracted signals were cached and are still referenced in the capital_logic sources list. The active document IDs are fe962646 and 932dd6be.

slots.company_description: Magarian Fund, LP — a long-biased, fundamentals-driven, concentrated equity hedge fund managed by Pine Valley Investments (PVI), an SEC-registered RIA founded in 2015. The fund employs a contrarian value approach with 8–16 high-conviction positions and a 12–24 month investment horizon.
slots.solution_summary: Concentrated equity strategy targeting undervalued, publicly traded companies. Uses options-based hedging for downside protection. Targets investment opportunities with 40–50% upside based on fundamental analysis.
slots.target_customer: Accredited investors / LPs. Minimum investment $1,000,000. Class A LP structure with GP co-investment.
slots.product_type: Hedge fund LP — not a startup or operating company. No product, no ARR, no burn rate.
slots.delivery_model: LP fund vehicle. Investors subscribe as limited partners. Management fee + incentive fee structure.
slots.raise_note: No traditional startup 'raise'. The fund accepts LP subscriptions on an ongoing basis with a $1,000,000 minimum. There is no declared target raise amount or round label. capital_logic_v1.raise.present = false is correct.
slots.vertical_domain: Asset management / hedge fund — pipeline classifies vertical as 'other' (no specific vertical tag for hedge fund strategies)
slots.aum_note: Total Strategy AUM: $222mm — $57mm in the Magarian Fund LP + $165mm in Legacy SMA. PVI total AUM: $2.5B.
slots.fund_manager: Pine Valley Investments (PVI), SEC-registered RIA. RIA managing $2.5B total AUM.
slots.portfolio_construction: 8–16 positions, concentrated value, contrarian, 12–24 month horizon, options-based hedging

financials._note: No XLSX. No startup-style financials. The fund does not have ARR, burn rate, CAC, or LTV. Financial metrics are fund-performance metrics (AUM, returns, fees). financial_breakdown_v1.data_quality = 'missing' is the correct expected state — there are no P&L or cash flow statements for the fund itself.

aum.evidence: PD PDF page 1: 'Total Strategy AUM: $222 million- $57m in the Magarian Fund and $165m…'. This is verified across the existing deal_understanding GT and the DPU source content.

raise.evidence: No startup raise present. Fund accepts LP subscriptions; no disclosed target raise amount. structured_summary.kpis.raise.value = 'Unknown' is correct. capital_logic_v1.raise.present = false is correct.

revenue.evidence: Fund has no operating revenue. structured_summary.kpis.revenue should not have a valid amount. Any extracted revenue value is noise from portfolio company case studies or markting materials (see BUG-MFUND-1).

portfolio_revenue_as_fund_revenue_BUG_MF.evidence: structured_summary.kpis.revenue.candidates[0].amount = 3.6 (raw: '$4', confidence: 0.66), sourced from doc:fe962646:page:18. Source snippet: 'Case Study - KGC Amidst Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Kinross faced a 50% sell-off, despite only 10% of revenue coming from Russian operations.' The text 'revenue' appears in a portfolio holding case study — the DPU extracted it as a fund revenue signal. A hedge fund LP has no operating revenue.

wrong_funding_stage_BUG_MFUND_2.evidence: funding_stage_v1.funding_stage = 'pre_seed' (signal: company_phase_label:pre_seed, weight 0.6, confidence 0.6). The fund has been in operation since April 2019 with $222mm+ AUM and 762% total net return. It is not in a pre-seed startup stage. The pre_seed classification fires because the fund has no product/milestone/raise signals that match operating company stage models.

null_worker_archetype_BUG_MFUND_3.evidence: business_archetype_v1 in DIO analyzer_results is absent/null. The fund_spv classification is correctly surfaced in investment_analysis_overview_v2.archetype (value: 'fund_spv', confidence: 0.57) and dio_context.deal_type. But the worker-layer archetype analyzer does not emit evidence rules for fund_spv. This means there are no archetype evidence rule hits to validate against, unlike startup archetypes.

stale_capital_sources_BUG_MFUND_4.correct_value: sources should reference fe962646 and 932dd6be only
stale_capital_sources_BUG_MFUND_4.evidence: The capital_logic_v1 raise sources array contains references to soft-deleted duplicate document IDs (93c64280, 2b55cd4c). These were duplicate uploads that were soft-deleted via the admin API. The active documents are fe962646 (PD, 33pp) and 932dd6be (Financials, 2pp). Stale references indicate cache invalidation on soft-delete is incomplete.

noise_checks.label: AUM must not appear as raise_amount
noise_checks.note: Fund AUM is $222mm. This figure must not be extracted or promoted as a startup raise amount. structured_summary.kpis.raise.value = 'Unknown' is the correct expected state. Any non-Unknown raise value for this deal is noise from AUM/performance data.

noise_checks.label: capital_logic raise must be absent (fund, not startup raise)
noise_checks.note: No startup raise exists. Hedge fund LP subscriptions are not equivalent to startup equity rounds. capital_logic_v1.raise.present = false is the correct expected state.

noise_checks.label: Revenue value must not exist (no fund operating revenue)
noise_checks.note: BUG-MFUND-1 noise guard: The fund has no operating revenue. financial_breakdown_v1.current_state.revenue should be null. Revenue extracted from portfolio company case studies (e.g., KGC Kinross Gold) is noise. Checks financial_breakdown, not structured_summary.kpis (which has the noisy $3.6 value from the DPU).

noise_checks.label: Promoted facts count must be <= 2 (fund produces minimal promotable facts)
noise_checks.note: Fund pipeline currently promotes 2 facts: business_model_v1 and revenue_v1 (noisy). The revenue_v1 promoted fact is itself a noise artifact (BUG-MFUND-1). If promoted_facts count increases above 2, a new extraction is being promoted that warrants review.

report_checks.label: deal_type must be fund_spv
report_checks.note: Core classification is correct. Magarian Fund is a hedge fund LP — fund_spv is the correct deal_type. Must not regress to startup_raise, de_spac, or real_estate.

report_checks.label: stage must be fund_ops
report_checks.note: Operational fund since April 2019 with $222mm+ AUM. stage = fund_ops is the correct expected state. Must not regress to seed, series_a, or growth_stage.

report_checks.label: business_model must be Fund / SPV investment vehicle
report_checks.note: The policy guard 'startup_operating_label_suppressed_for_fund' correctly overrides DTC Ecommerce (the raw label, triggered by email/sms mention in a subscription email footer). The fund_spv policy label assignment produces 'Fund / SPV investment vehicle' as the display. This guard must remain active.

report_checks.label: deal_summary_v1 hero must be Fund / SPV investment vehicle
report_checks.note: The hero label propagated from business_model classification. Must not show a startup-class hero label (e.g., 'SaaS platform', 'B2B software') for this fund.

report_checks.label: context confidence must be >= 0.70
report_checks.note: Current confidence is 0.7125. The fund_spv classification has moderate confidence — if this drops below 0.70, the fund signals are weakening and the classification may be at risk of misclassifying into another archetype.

report_checks.label: financial_breakdown data_quality must be missing
report_checks.note: No XLSX, no structured financial model exists for this fund. data_quality = 'missing' is the correct expected state. If this changes to 'partial' or 'full', a document was incorrectly classified as a financial model.

report_checks.label: financial_breakdown has_xlsx must be false
report_checks.note: No XLSX present. Both docs are PDFs (fund presentation + performance summary). has_xlsx = false must be stable.

dio_checks.label: dio_context.deal_type must be fund_spv
dio_checks.note: Worker-layer DIO context correctly identifies fund_spv. This is the upstream classification that the compiler propagates.

dio_checks.label: dio_context.stage must be fund_ops
dio_checks.note: Worker-layer stage classification must be fund_ops. If this changes, the core stage classification will also change.

dio_checks.label: investment_analysis_overview_v2 archetype value must be fund_spv
dio_checks.note: investment_analysis_overview_v2.archetype.value = 'fund_spv' (confidence 0.57). This is the only archetype signal visible at the report layer (business_archetype_v1 is null at the worker layer per BUG-MFUND-3). Must remain fund_spv.

dio_checks.label: business_archetype_v1 from DIO must be fund_spv
dio_checks.note: BUG-MFUND-3 RESOLVED. Worker now correctly emits business_archetype_v1 = 'fund_spv' for this LP fund deal (confidence 0.57, evidence rules fund:lp_gp and fund:carry_fees). If this regresses to null, the archetype analyzer has stopped producing output for fund deals. If it changes to consumer_product or de_spac, that is a classification regression.

evidence_checks.label: business_model_v1 has_fund_signals must be true
evidence_checks.note: The promoted business_model_v1 fact must have diagnostics.has_fund_signals = true. This is the signal that triggers the fund_spv policy guard and suppresses incorrect startup labels. If has_fund_signals = false, the guard will not fire and the fund may be misclassified as DTC Ecommerce.

evidence_checks.label: business_model_v1 startup guard must be applied
evidence_checks.note: The 'startup_operating_label_suppressed_for_fund' guard must appear in the applied_guards array of the business_model_v1 promoted fact. This guard is what converts the raw DTC-Ecommerce label to 'Fund / SPV investment vehicle'. If this guard disappears, fund classification degrades.
